acceptance: Every M1 type is code in its owner's `types.py` (`LEVELS`, `FEATURES` and the seed constants are final values); each `tests/contracts/<id>.<Type>/` sample (StepResult, Frame, Transition, Recording, Artifact, RunConfig, EvalResult, ViewResult, ResultsTable) validates against its schema
Every M1 step, library class method and `EpsilonSchedule.value` imports with its contract signature and body `raise NotImplementedError("<task id>")`; each `__init__.py` exports its contract
`cli/main.py` parses `train`, `view`, `export` and `inspect-table` into their entry stubs; `python -m gridlab.cli --help` lists them
TC-14 passes; `render()` gives a 1×N Frame; `obs_labels` are `pos_0…pos_9`
TC-01–TC-09 pass (movement, eating, death, tail cell, win, starvation), via `set_state` with the 11-feature observation still stubbed
TC-12 and TC-13 pass (food placement, determinism)
≥ 10,000 random steps per second on L3 (QR-03, slow-marked timing test)
TC-10 passes (four states, plus the no-danger variant; the tail cell isn't danger)
TC-11 passes (shaping 0.1 and off)
TC-19 passes; the greedy agent rejects an observation that isn't 11 features long
3,000 random-agent steps give each action a 30–37% share (BASE-01)
TC-17 passes; bounds outside 0 ≤ end ≤ start ≤ 1 or `decay_steps` < 1 raise `ValueError`
TC-15 and TC-16 pass (hand-computed updates; truncation bootstraps, termination doesn't)
Saved to `.npz` and reloaded, the agent gives the same greedy actions; no reinforcement-learning library is imported

`make_env("corridor")`, `make_env("snake", "L2", shaping=0.1)` and `make_agent(name, env, seed)` for random, greedy and tabular build the classes the contract names, with overrides applied; unknown names raise `ValueError` listing the valid ones
`create` makes `seed<N>-<timestamp>/` exclusively with `config.json` (`complete: false`); a second create of the same config makes a second folder
`log_episode`, `log_curve`, `save_final`, `save_recording` and `close` write the files AD-06 lists, flushed per write
On the corridor with a random agent, the result has 100 scores aligned with `FINAL_EVAL_SEEDS`, end-cause counts summing to 100, and the agent's state unchanged
A corridor episode of T steps gives T+1 frames, T actions and rewards, T+1 scores; `values` is None for a random agent
On the EvalResult sample's seeds, it returns two Recordings, of the best- and median-scoring seeds, each validating as core.Recording
On the corridor with a random agent for 1,000 steps, exactly 1,000 env steps run, one episode row per episode with all six fields, and a curve point every `eval_every` steps
`steps == 0` runs no step; Ctrl-C (simulated) closes the run with `complete: false` and re-raises
After `save_outputs`, the run folder holds `final_eval.json`, the agent, `recordings/best.npz` and `median.npz`, and `config.json` says `complete: true`
